craft_notes: Sthāyin: order-joy. yajedvīraḥ fused (subject in verb); punaryajanamārabhet fused. Close: pursuit. Rejected: 'box' — killed.

lines: There let the hero worship forthgoing, then the seat anew;
casketed, let him the worship-practice pursue.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ yajedvīraḥ punarevāsanaṃ tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya punaryajanamārabhet |

reads_against.argmap: There the hero should worship emanation, then the seat; casketed, again worship begins.
c1_essence: Hero worships emanation, then seat; casketed, begin.
